listing.name: Civilization Revolution — ReRevved (ReRevvedRecomp)
listing.summary: This primarily uses static recompilation. The reviewed README does not claim that the full game works. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox 360 ISO or extracted content with the version 1.3 title update. Check the project’s importer manifest for the supported title ID, media ID and hash before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run the released rerevved.exe to import the game, then TU1.3. The Windows x64 player uses D3D12; the Linux x64 build is experimental.

warnings: This primarily uses static recompilation. The reviewed README does not claim that the full game works.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
